reports.subject: Adverse event report: VY-201
reports.text:
Dear Drug Safety Team,

I am a consultant physician at a sample hospital in Pune, India. I am reporting a 62-year-old male patient (initials R.K.) who was started on VY-201 50 mg orally once daily for hypertension on {d-14}. On {d-6} he developed severe angioedema of the lips and tongue and was admitted to hospital. VY-201 was discontinued and he was treated with intravenous steroids. The swelling resolved after discontinuation and he was discharged on {d-4}. He has a history of type 2 diabetes. Please contact me on the hospital line for follow-up.

Regards,
Consultant physician (FICTIONAL)

reports.subject: My mother felt dizzy on VY-412
reports.text:
Hello,

My mother, aged 74, has been taking VY-412 250 mg capsules for joint pain since {d-30}. Last week she felt very dizzy and had a fall at home. She did not need to go to hospital. She stopped the capsules on {d-3} and is feeling better now. I am her son and my phone number is available on request.

Thank you
